paragraphs.text: Nivea was a mage from Otaria , on the plane of Dominaria .
Nivea was beautiful, brilliant, and bold, garbed in white robes and bedecked in jewels.

Nivea worked as a mage in the Order of the northern plains until its decimation. Abandoning the remnants of her comrades, she traveled south to Aphetto , where she met Ixidor , an illusionist who worked as a street fortune teller using cards, and they quickly fell in love.

Nivea partnered with her love to make their living betting on themselves in the Cabal pit fights. Nivea specialized in summoning white creatures, such as pikemen and aven , while Ixidor created illusory copies of them, while at the same time cloaking the real creatures in invisibility. She died at the hands of Phage in a Cabal pit fight.
In his grief, Ixidor created the angel Akroma in her image.

Due to her blue hair and pale appearance resembling Akroma, the mage on Onslaught ' Chain of Vapor and Mage's Guile was long speculated to be Nivea. When Nivea received her first card in Mystery Booster Commander Edition , her appearance confirmed that she was the character depicted.
In the Echoverse , Nivea survives, and instead her lover dies in a battle with Tolarian wizards . Consumed by rage and grief, Nivea made Akroma to avenge their death.
